posts.title: Setting Up Arch on an Old ThinkPad
posts.description: Recently, I bought a used ThinkPad X230 for around $60. It came with a 3rd-gen i7 CPU, 8GB RAM, and a 180GB SSD. Decent specs for a family laptop. posts.title: How I Made jopen?
posts.description: jopen is a blog about mostly tech-related projects I do for fun. In fact, jopen itself is one of them! I wanted to take notes on the process of my projects, and there was no reason to keep them private. So, I made this blog, To Learn In Public . I don’t like bloated CMSs.
